summary.name: Malwarebytes for Mac
summary.one_liner: Post-download page for Malwarebytes' Mac installer, which also promotes paid Malwarebytes Premium Security and related subscription plans.
use_cases: Remove malware or spyware from a Mac
Get real-time antivirus protection for multiple devices
Add VPN or identity theft protection to security software
Block ads and trackers in a browser
summary.what_it_does: The page is a download confirmation for Malwarebytes for Mac, with a prompt to restart the download if it does not begin automatically. It mainly promotes Malwarebytes Premium Security, which the page says provides 24/7 real-time protection against viruses, trojans, spyware, ransomware, exploits and malicious sites. It lists Standard, Plus and Ultimate plans for individuals and Family plans for households, with a Privacy VPN, Identity Theft Protection, Browser Guard and Personal Data Remover as add-on products. Pricing is shown in US dollars per year, with some listed prices struck through as promotional discounts.
notable: Malwarebytes Premium Security offers 24/7 real-time protection
Bundled tiers combine antivirus, Privacy VPN, and identity theft protection
Browser Guard blocks ads, trackers and scams
Personal Data Remover removes personal info from data broker and people-search sites
caveats: Premium plans are paid subscriptions, with prices starting at $59.99/yr for Standard and higher for Plus and Ultimate
Identity theft protection and Personal Data Remover are available in the US only
The page says exact features vary by operating system
Listed as Freeware in the awesome-mac list, but the page itself promotes paid plans
